schema.description: v2 adds human_check and drops agent_review.recommended and agent_review.reason: every change gets one agent review.

floor.description: Minimum tier set by rules; tier is never below it

impact.description: How costly a mistake would be

uncertainty.description: How weakly the change was verified

action.description: What the user should do, one sentence, from the policy preset or .brisk.yaml actions

human_check.description: Whether a person should look at the change too, on top of the one agent review every change gets, and what they should think about. Decided by the policy (human_check in .brisk.yaml) from the tier, rule hits, and Jev's answers. Separate from the tier: a Medium change can need a person.

why.description: The kind of condition that asked for a person; empty when not needed

reason.description: One sentence of brisk's fixed text plus numbers; never an ID or text from the repository or its config. Empty when not needed.

consider.description: At most two questions for the person, from the top of agent_review.plan; empty when not needed. Text is brisk's catalog (source brisk; change_scope when the plan is empty) or the first check of the team's review_checks (source config), never model text. Evidence paths and symbols are repository text.

id.description: The plan area it comes from, or change_scope

agent_review.description: Guidance for the agent review every change gets before it ships.

context_files.description: Repository paths a reviewer should read for the project's rules, such as the business_rules file. Paths only; the file's text is not copied here.

plan.description: Where a reviewer should look and what to check, most important first; may be empty. Area and check text come from brisk's catalog (source brisk) or the base .brisk.yaml review_checks (source config); the model only scores areas. Evidence paths and symbols are repository text.

required.description: From a High rule or model override; never dropped by tailoring

score.description: The model's relevance score, when the plan was tailored

preset.description: Policy preset from the base commit's .brisk.yaml, with the earlier names autonomous, reviewed and strict reported as light, balanced and careful; balanced when it names none

thresholds.description: Model risk thresholds the policy used

review_plan.description: How the model tailored agent_review.plan; absent when the plan is empty.

status.description: tailored: the model's scores were applied. not_asked: the policy (agent_review.tailor_plan never, or needed with no person asked) or a rules-only run did not ask. pending: the policy wanted review answers but none were given. failed: the review call failed; see error. Only tailored changes the plan.

tailored.description: status is tailored. Otherwise the plan is brisk's full list, required areas first, then in hit order

dropped.description: Area IDs scored below 1; required areas are never dropped

policy_note.description: Why the policy could not be applied in full, such as a share with no risk quantiles for this model; the tier then uses the calibration's thresholds. The model still answered.

degraded.description: Set when a model backend failed and brisk fell back to rules only
